title: Shelby County revises dates for Hard Steel Bid #2026-4-11665
text:
Shelby County officials announced on May 5 that key dates have been revised for the Hard Steel Bid #2026-4-11665. The location for the bid opening remains at the office of the Chief Financial Officer, located at 200 West College Street, Room 125, Columbiana, Alabama.
The update is important for vendors and interested parties who are preparing to participate in the bidding process. Staying informed about these changes ensures that all participants can meet deadlines and submit required materials properly.
According to county officials, all questions concerning bid specifications must be submitted to Mary Horton at mhorton@shelbyal.com no later than noon on May 4, 2026. Responses to these questions will be posted to the eBid Portal by close of business on May 6, if appropriate. The public opening and reading of bids is now scheduled for May 14 at 2:30 p.m.
These changes are intended to give bidders clear guidance on how and when they may engage with county procurement processes. Officials say that maintaining a transparent timeline helps ensure fairness throughout the process.
The adjustments reflect Shelby County’s ongoing efforts to keep stakeholders informed about any updates or modifications related to official bids. Further information regarding this bid will be made available through official channels as needed.
